rv.q: 3/5 stars. There may be a great play inside Good Bones...needs a bit more fleshing out.

We don’t really know where we are in Good Bones, the provocative new drama from James Ijames (the Pulitzer Prize–winning and Tony-nominated Fat Ham). We could be in New York, since we’re at the Public Theater. We could be in Washington, D.C., home to the Studio Theatre, which commissioned and first produced Good Bones in 2023.

vr.q: this play still grounds its conversations in a reasonably believable plot with pretty developed characters
